state_graph: disjoint union of two directed 6-cycles, one for each side/sweep orientation
SCCs: exactly two strongly connected components of size 6
state_return: every legitimate lifted state has minimal positive return time 6; returns occur exactly at multiples of 6
free_endpoint_return: projected free endpoint also has minimal positive return time 6 along each oriented lifted path
reversal: the two directed cycles are exchanged and orientation reversed; reversal gives the inverse path family
quantifier: for every one-step A1 anchor and for both legitimate side-cell lifts, the unique all-admissible stateful escape path closes after exactly six jumps
